newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh signs deal with Enron for power plant.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh signs deal with Enron for power plant.

text.p: Bangladesh's state-owned Power Development Board has signed a deal with a consortium led by Enron International to build a $91.5 million barge-mounted power plant, board officials said on Saturday.

They said an agreement on the 100-megawatt plant at Haripur near Dhaka was signed here in the capital with Enron and three of its associates -- Wartsila Diesel and New England Power Company of the United States and Fortune Limited of Bangladesh.
They said Enron was also expected to win deals for two more barge-mounted power plants.
Bangladesh faces a severe power crisis as the country generates only 1,850 megawatts against demand of 2,000 megawatts.
The officials said Bangladesh was seeking overseas investment to raise power generation to 3,100 megawatts by the year 2,000 and 4,600 megawatts by 2005.
